name: Jeyell
description: Jeyell was a Mid Rim Territories planet located in the Near Perlemian area that was taken over by the Rebel Alliance during its failed Mid Rim Offensive and then evacuated when the Galactic Empire made a counterpush in 2 ABY. After rumors were leaked of a high-ranking rebel heading toward the Near Perlemian in 4 ABY, the Cynabar's InfoNet news report listed Jeyell and three other worlds as possible locations of rebel activity. The Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Overseer fought and defeated several EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates at Jeyell by 4 ABY.
